title: How Will You Measure Your Life? Clay Christensen at TEDxBoston
summary: Clayton Christensen's TEDx talk applying business theory to personal life. He argues that career success is not the right measure of a life and urges attention to relationships and values.
why: HN commenters share it as an inspiring reflection on what to optimize in life beyond career, especially in threads on burnout and meaning.

quote.text: This is a very inspiring presentation, especially towards the end.
